easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
